sourceNotes: 聚合模式支持分别选择菜单栏与状态总览的展示项目
支持拖动调整聚合监控项目与 AI 服务顺序，AI 顺序同步到菜单栏、聚合圆点和额度小组件
优化菜单栏设置布局，统一网络样式与 IP 归属地控件对齐，并让 AI 服务选择铺满可用宽度
修复额度小组件的默认灰环挤掉实际服务，以及取消勾选后排序和备份丢失服务位置的问题
修复首次开启自定义展示位置时重新启用已关闭监控功能的问题
完善网络检测取消后的恢复，排除非公网测试地址的归属查询

en: Choose separate menu-bar and Status Overview items in combined mode. Enable Customize Display Locations in Advanced settings when needed (#22).
Drag to reorder combined monitoring items and AI services. Share the AI order across menu-bar indicators, combined dots and quota widgets.
Refine menu-bar settings, align the network style and IP location controls, and let AI service selection use the available width.
Keep default gray quota rings from displacing services present in Magpie. Preserve hidden service positions when reordering and restoring backups.
Fix enabling custom display locations for the first time unexpectedly turning disabled monitoring features back on.
Improve recovery after cancelling network tests and exclude non-public test addresses from geolocation queries.
